description: Maiden bowling rating model v1. Latent = shrunk weighted mean of blended (tournament+era) percentile features; percentiles are already direction-corrected so higher = better (low economy/average/SR score high). See docs/rating-methodology.md.

excluded_features.bowl_wickets_per_innings: highly correlated with wickets; excluded from v1 to avoid double counting
excluded_features.bowl_five_wickets/bowl_maidens: sparse milestone counts; not in v1 latent
